ctx.x: In fact, he had two pianists. Two pianists. I forgot the girl's name now. She was a very good piano player. Anyway, we did... I worked with Wilbur Sweatman. During that time, we weren't getting no more than the scale. The scale was fifty-five dollars a week.
My first time with Wilbur Sweatman, I went back with Dave Nelson. And I went back again with Eubie Blake. Because Eubie Blake had a fourteen-piece band.
